source: Organiser's own pages (amsterdamdanceevent.com FAQ, About ADE, ticket page), read 2026-10-30: 2027 dates 20 to 24 October, 2026 dates 21 to 25 October, Pro Pass rules (personal, ID at pick-up, limited capacity at high-demand venues, ADE Lab not included, Weeztix, no day or conference-only passes, 2027 price unpublished), 2025 figures (600,000 visitors, 11,000 professionals), 1,200+ events in 300+ locations, founded 1996. Venue examples (Gashouder, Ziggo Dome, AFAS Live, Johan Cruijff Arena, Concertgebouw, Westerkerk, Felix Meritis) from the ADE 2026 programme pages. Awakenings ADE special since 2012: awakenings-draft.md. Image: Wikimedia Commons, File:Azotti in Amsterdam Dance Event.jpg. Sets: selector-data.json.
